observations: Photo 0 shows a large collection of electric irons arranged in rows on a concrete surface.
The irons vary in color (blue, white, green, red, black, etc.) and design.
Some irons have visible power cords and bases, while others appear to be dry iron or non-electric.
The setting appears to be an outdoor or semi-outdoor space with metal shutters or doors in the background.
No brand or model is visible on any of the irons in the photo.
The seller claims they are 'clean imported pressing iron' and 'Direct uk used'.

No visible proof of origin or usage history. The seller's claim cannot be verified from the photo.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.proof: Close-up photos of each iron's base, cord, and heating element, showing condition and functionality.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially non-functional or damaged

risks.risk: The irons may not be genuine or may be counterfeit, especially if 'Direct uk used' is a misleading claim.
risks.proof: Photos of the brand name, model number, and serial number on each iron, or a clear shot of the packaging or label.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic or unbranded, with lower value

risks.risk: The irons may be used or refurbished, not 'bought new last year' as claimed.
risks.proof: Photos showing the age of the irons (e.g., serial numbers, labels, or packaging) or a receipt or proof of purchase.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used, with lower value

proof_requests: Close-up photos of each iron's base, cord, and heating element to check for damage or wear.
Photos of the brand name, model number, and serial number on each iron.
Photos of the packaging or any labels that might indicate origin or condition.
Proof of purchase or receipt if available.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
